---
description: Explain one CDS business or technical flow in plain Thai with a concrete example and checks.
---

Read `docs/field-guide.md`, `docs/requirements.md`, `docs/decisions.md` and the latest contract. Explain the requested flow in Thai for a teammate who is new to this topic. Start with a one-sentence purpose, then show who acts, what data changes, what can fail, and how we prove it with a test or demo. Distinguish confirmed rules from examples and pending answers. Use one synthetic example and avoid code unless asked. If no flow is specified, explain the withdrawal → history → eligible receipt distinction and why a newly created request may not be immediately receivable. Do not edit files.
